note: The disjoint quick-test shards of MS05r6b for the final source (inventories of this folder). Inputs of manifest.js. It is the draft plan of MS05r5m (evidence/MS05r5m/shard-plan.json) with the manual-corpus suite (MS05b3) added to own-fast and the projections restated for IR12: every projection is finite and per item, a measurement at an earlier quick fingerprint of the same code (MS05r6a, 00345dc1, locked; the code of these suites is unchanged since, only AGENTS.md, the guides and the designs differ) times a stated margin, or else a stated conservative bound for the complete item, start-up and registration included. projectionBasis starts with MEASURED (an earlier fingerprint of the same code, with its margin), STALE (an older tree) or UNMEASURED (a ceiling from earlier evidence). A selector is one command: the node runner with --suite=<names> only, or no option for the whole app.
